description: Réseau de transport – Voie navigable en Wallonie (BE) is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPW-SG Secrétariat général. This data layer includes stream segments in Wallonia that comply with the specifications of the INSPIRE Transport Network – Navigation sub-theme. The European Directive 2007/2/EC - INSPIRE Directive - establishes an infrastructure for spatial information in the European Community. INSPIRE applies to 34 thematic areas divided into 3 Annexes. Coverage: SPW-SG Secrétariat général. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE - Transport network – Inland waterway in Wallonia (BE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SPW-SG Secrétariat général. Its keywords include rivière, eau, cours d'eau navigable, fleuve, Régional, cours d'eau. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GMZ, GEOJSON, WMS. The listing shows 2019-05-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
